node.statement: For every q, write c_q:=I_q tensor c and b_q:=I_q tensor b. From Delta_q(Y)=b_q*Delta-prime_q(Y)*b_q and c_q*b_q=b_q*c_q=I, one has Delta-prime_q(Y)=c_q*Delta_q(Y)*c_q. Consequently Delta-prime_q(Y)-Delta_q(Y)=(c_q-I)*Delta_q(Y)*c_q+Delta_q(Y)*(c_q-I), whence contractivity of Delta_q and ||c_q-I||=s, ||c_q||=||c||<=1+s imply ||Delta-prime_q(Y)-Delta_q(Y)|| <= s*(2+s)*||Y|| <= 3*d*||Y||. Taking the supremum over q gives ||Delta-prime-Delta||_cb <= 3*d.
